title: MERGE-XAI-SYNC C-07 (PIN M7, MAV2 child projection + mailbox) — sol parent (frozen lane L-01 responses) spawns a v2 subagent on the qwen lane (L-04 responses); the 06 §2 C-07 scenario: 'spawn v2 subagent, exchange one message parent→child→parent'. One bounded turn (AT-SPAWN-XWIRE pattern, 600s headroom): the parent spawns a background worker with model qwen3.8-27b; the child sends the parent exactly MXAI-C07-PART1 via send_message; the parent wait_agents and quotes it back (PART1-RECEIVED … CHILD-ACK). M7 wire face on the child's FIRST request (the OLDEST qwen request in this run — where {POST /v1/responses, body.model=qwen3.8-27b}: every qwen request is the child's; the parent is sol): (1) MIRROR-PRESENT: the child's tools[] is the parent's VerbatimMirror builtin inventory — the non-collab builtins run_terminal_command + read_file appear as tool-schema entries (the '"name": "…"' form — prompt-text-independent); (2) V2-COLLAB-KEPT: the v2 collab tool send_message is KEPT on the child (exempt from the projection drop list — the 5 v2 collab tools are the exemption set); (3) V1-COLLAB-DROPPED: the v1 ActiveAgentMessage tool send_subagent_message is ABSENT from the child's first request (the drop the projection exists to make — crate-verified, child_tool_projection.rs: VerbatimMirror minus send_subagent_message ONLY). CONTROL (anti-vacuous): a qwen child request exists (child_ran). The mailbox pin (part1) + the terminal (CHILD-ACK) close the round-trip. VERDICT: PASS = the child ran 1..6 requests with a 200 final, mirror/kept/dropped all green, PART1 reached the parent, no error terminal. VACUOUS (model class, child_ran/part1/done): the model never spawned / never sent / never closed — recorded, never a silent pass. STOP-AND-REPORT (house rule): an acp_error, a child request storm (>6), or a non-200 final on the child boundary (new phrasing = triage).

steps.prompt: Use the spawn_agent tool to start a background agent named worker with model qwen3.8-27b (pass model: qwen3.8-27b in the tool arguments). In its message, give it this task: use the send_message tool to send the parent agent (root) a message containing exactly: MXAI-C07-PART1, and only then finish. After spawning, use wait_agent to wait for the worker to finish, then reply with exactly: PART1-RECEIVED <the exact message the worker sent you> CHILD-ACK

steps.note: M7 SURFACE (recon_note, non-scoring): the child's first request (the oldest qwen capture, last:0 under the where scope) is the projection surface — tools[] there is the VerbatimMirror verdict (mirror-present + v2-collab-kept + v1-collab-dropped). The qwen where-filter is child-scoped: the parent is sol, so every body.model=qwen3.8-27b /v1/responses request in this run is the child's. The companion child_calls count band (1..6) bounds N for the last:0 selection (the B-i count-tolerance lesson). The mailbox round-trip is ndjson-scored (part1 + done) — the wire face of the mailbox is the plaintext text frame (the MA-4 opaque-carrier defect class would surface as an error terminal, not a wire pin).

ndjson.label: NO TERMINAL ERROR: the spawn turn completed without an unrecovered error.
SESSION SURVIVES: an unrecovered 400/503 on the parent or the child boundary surfaces here (Fatal tail) -> STOP.
MAILBOX ROUND-TRIP: the child's PART1 frame reached the parent's context and was quoted back (spawn + send_message + wait_agent cycle closed — the 06 C-07 'one message parent→child→parent' half).
TERMINAL ACK: the spawn turn closed with the exact terminal token.

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): a /v1/responses request with body.model=qwen3.8-27b exists — the child actually ran on its own model+wire (every qwen request in this case is the child's). 0-hit = the model never spawned the child = every M7 pin below is vacuous.

M7 MIRROR-PRESENT (1 of 2): the child's FIRST request (oldest qwen capture, last:0 — bounded by child_calls) carries the builtin run_terminal_command as a tools[] schema entry — the child's tool set is the parent's VerbatimMirror, not a reduced set. Absent = the mirror projection did not fire = the M7 pin regressed -> defect.

M7 MIRROR-PRESENT (2 of 2): the child's first request also carries the builtin read_file as a tools[] schema entry (a second non-collab builtin — one shared defect cannot zero both mirror pins). Absent = the mirror projection did not fire = defect.

M7 V2-COLLAB-KEPT: the child's first request carries the v2 collab tool send_message as a tools[] schema entry — the v2 collab set (send_message, followup_task, list_agents, wait_agent, interrupt_agent) is EXEMPT from the projection drop (children keep them; crate-verified child_tool_projection.rs). The '"name":' form is prompt-independent (the spawn task text mentions send_message plain, which does NOT match this pattern). Absent = the exemption regressed (the projection dropped the v2 collab set) = defect.

M7 V1-COLLAB-DROPPED: the v1 ActiveAgentMessage-kind tool send_subagent_message must be ABSENT from the child's first request — it is the ONE tool the projection drops (SEND_SUBAGENT_MESSAGE_TOOL_NAME; the spawn prompt never mentions it, so any hit is a tools[]/context leak). Present = the projection did not apply its v1 drop = the M7 pin regressed = defect -> STOP.
CHILD REQUEST BAND (bounds N for the last:0 M7 pins — B-i lesson): 1-4 = clean (spawn + task + mailbox turns); >6 = storm -> STOP; 0 = the child never ran (the premise, already carried by child_ran).
CHILD NO-BRICK: the final qwen (child) request reached 200 — a 400/503 on the child boundary = brick or new phrasing -> STOP.

M7 TOOL-INVENTORY RECORD (recon, child's first request): the verbatim tools[] name lines on the child's first request — the coordinator's review corpus for the full mirror (every builtin present, the v1 collab tool absent, the v2 collab set kept) beyond the three scored spot-checks. recon — always records, never fails.

vacuous_if.note: the model never spawned the qwen child — the M7 projection + mailbox probes never ran (temperament; recorded, never a silent pass).
the child's PART1 frame never reached the parent's merged text — the mailbox round-trip did not close (probe meaningless).
the spawn turn never closed with the CHILD-ACK terminal — the spawn+wait cycle did not complete (probe meaningless).
